    // Hooke's law for an isotropic material: twice the shear modulus times the
    // strain, plus the first Lame parameter times the volumetric strain on the
    // diagonal.
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hooke%27s_law#Isotropic_materials)
    ToStressState(strain: StrainState3D, moduli: LameParameters): StressState3D
    {
        var e = strain.Matrix;
        var twoMu = 2.0 * moduli.ShearModulus.Pascals;
        var volumetric = moduli.FirstParameter.Pascals * (e.M11 + e.M22 + e.M33);
        return StressState3D(SymmetricMatrix3x3(
            twoMu * e.M11 + volumetric, twoMu * e.M12, twoMu * e.M13,
            twoMu * e.M22 + volumetric, twoMu * e.M23,
            twoMu * e.M33 + volumetric));
    }
```

    // Hooke's law in the plane, using the Lame pair of the model's idealization.
    ToStressState(strain: StrainState2D, moduli: LameParameters): StressState2D
    {
        var lambda = moduli.FirstParameter.Pascals;
        var twoMu = 2.0 * moduli.ShearModulus.Pascals;
        return StressState2D(
            Pressure((lambda + twoMu) * strain.NormalX + lambda * strain.NormalY),
            Pressure(lambda * strain.NormalX + (lambda + twoMu) * strain.NormalY),
            Pressure(twoMu * strain.ShearXY * 0.5));
    }
```
